## Summary

## Type of Change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Feature

## Constitution Checklist

- [ ] The change preserves clean architecture boundaries.
- [ ] Public API, CLI, config, plugin, or report format changes are documented.
- [ ] Static typing was not weakened or bypassed.
- [ ] No placeholder implementations, dead code, or duplicated logic were introduced.
- [ ] Security-sensitive input, path, plugin, or serialization behavior is validated.
